Along way, also: converting dates actual date fields standardizing events field removing provider creating column (eg ApplicantFinishedArgyleSync ApplicantFinishedPinwheelSync become ApplicantFinishedSync) caseworker events filtered since focus applicants page view events (CbvPageView) dropped don’t useful properties pilot information added ease use across pilots, internally running set_pilot can subset dataset just syncing events contain information looking sync times. terribly useful , can run, clean_events add spacing remove repetitive “Applicant” events. function comes handy plotting data. data, see “ApplicantFinishedSync” become legible “Finished Sync”. sync time information stored within nested properties column. can extract using another emmytics function, extact_properties. title: Flag Completion Status at Event, Session, and/or Applicant Level — flag_completed
text: Creates binary completion flag columns web analytics dataframe, indicating whether applicant completed target event (ApplicantSharedIncomeSummary) event, session, /applicant level.

title: Flag Completion Status at Event, Session, and/or Applicant Level — flag_completed
Flag Completion Status at Event, Session, and/or Applicant Level — flag_completed
text: df dataframe containing web analytics data. Must include following columns: event Character. name tracked event. pilot Character factor. pilot group identifier, used grouping variable session- applicant-level flags. cbv_flow_id Character numeric. unique session identifier. Required "session" included type. distinct_id Character numeric. unique applicant identifier. Required "applicant" included type. type Character vector specifying completion flags generate. One : "event" Adds completed_event: TRUE row's event ApplicantSharedIncomeSummary, FALSE otherwise. "session" Adds completed_session: TRUE event within pilot + cbv_flow_id session completion event. "applicant" Adds completed_applicant: TRUE event across sessions pilot + distinct_id applicant completion event. Defaults c("event", "session", "applicant") (three).

title: Flag Completion Status at Event, Session, and/or Applicant Level — flag_completed
text: dataframe rows df, one following columns appended depending type: completed_event Logical. Row-level completion flag. Included "event" type. completed_session Logical. Session-level completion flag. Included "session" type. completed_applicant Logical. Applicant-level completion flag. Included "applicant" type.

title: Flag Completion Status at Event, Session, and/or Applicant Level — flag_completed
text: target completion event defined internally "ApplicantSharedIncomeSummary". row-level completed_event flag first created, session- applicant-level flags derived applying () within group. () returns TRUE least one value group TRUE, making aggregation logic explicit self-documenting. "event" included type, intermediate completed_event column dropped returned dataframe. Grouping configurations "session" "applicant" defined internally applied functionally via purrr::reduce(), making straightforward extend function additional grouping levels future.
